_meta.description: Expanded asset manifest with id, name, category, path, dimensions, anchor, and animation info

rules: category: directory name (enemies, weapons, props, tiles, ui, items, effects, player, bosses, backgrounds)
state: idle | move | attack | hit | death (omit for static sprites)
variant: optional variant suffix (01, 02, red, dark)
frame: zero-padded frame number for animation sequences (01, 02, 03)

animationFormat.frames: number of frames in the sprite sheet
animationFormat.frameW: width of each frame in pixels
animationFormat.frameH: height of each frame in pixels
